definitions.gloss: lost dog; stray dog that has wandered away from its owner
definitions.explanation: A pet dog that has become separated from its owner and is wandering. Distinguished from a permanently stray or feral dog — a 迷い犬 has an owner somewhere.

examples.japanese: {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保護|ほご}した→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧。
examples.english: I took in a lost dog.

examples.japanese: {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲示板|けいじばん}→掲示板：03052_keijiban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}せた→載せる：28290_noseru⟧。
examples.english: I posted information about a lost dog on the bulletin board.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけた→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}けた→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: I spotted a lost dog in the neighborhood, so I reported it at the police box.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拡散|かくさん}したら→拡散する：18995_kakusansuru⟧、⟦{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}→飼い主：15281_kainushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: After sharing the lost dog's photo on social media, the owner was found.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{迷|まよ}い→迷い：19437_mayoi⟧ (wandering, lost — the continuative form of ⟦{迷|まよ}う→迷う：02426_mayou⟧) and ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧ (dog). The ⟦{迷|まよ}い→迷い：19437_mayoi⟧～ pattern creates compounds meaning 'lost/stray ~': {迷|まよ}い{猫|ねこ} (lost cat), {迷|まよ}い{子|こ} (lost child).

In Japan, if you find a {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}, you can take it to the nearest ⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧ (police box) or contact the local {動物愛護|どうぶつあいご}⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧ (animal welfare center). Many municipalities now also use social media and dedicated websites to reunite lost pets with their owners.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保護|ほご}する→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧: to take in/shelter a lost dog
- {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{届|とど}け→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧: lost dog report
- {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}→飼い主：15281_kainushi⟧: the owner of a lost dog
- {迷|まよ}い{犬|いぬ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かける→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧: to spot a lost dog

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{野良犬|のらいぬ}→野良犬：14464_norainu⟧: stray dog — a dog without an owner, living on its own permanently
- {迷|まよ}い{猫|ねこ}: lost cat — the feline equivalent
- {迷|まよ}い{子|こ}: lost child — a child who has become separated from their parent or guardian
